sources.title: Soccer Match Event Dataset - Players
sources.publisher: Luca Pappalardo and Emanuele Massucco via Figshare; player metadata collected by Wyscout
sources.version_season: Players item v3, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.7765196.v3; file ID 15073721
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 as displayed by the Figshare v3 API; attribution, license link, change indication, and no-endorsement wording required
sources.sha256: players.json 877a111cb1005b73df5645e9338bd74fb4b496bace2fbc545a72abb3b73efa2e (1737347 bytes); publisher/computed MD5 f28ddf6326281efeda6488b2169f5609; download https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/15073721
sources.schema_units: JSON player dimension, 3603 rows; locally verified wyId is present and unique in all rows. Product transform admits only wyId and one-pass Unicode-decoded, NFC-normalized, trimmed shortName.
sources.coverage: Current fixed example joins Portugal group-stage corner takers 14/14 and first recorded follow-up actors 14/14; Uruguay group-stage first recorded defending actors 6/6. The existing 5 classifiable plus 1 placeholder endpoint boundary remains unchanged.
sources.known_gaps: playerId names the player associated with a recorded event; it does not prove physical first contact, reception, duel victory, marking assignment, reach, or causal effect. CC BY does not grant publicity, privacy, personality, trademark, or endorsement rights. Source shortName strings contain literal Unicode escapes that require deterministic one-pass normalization.
sources.product_use: Link player IDs to factual short display names in separate Portugal attack, Uruguay defensive-exposure, and held-out match event records. The identity is only the actor associated with the recorded event. Do not expose full-name composition, birth/passport data, height, weight, preferred foot, role, current team IDs, photos, flags, crests, evaluative or performance rankings, recommendations, physical-contact claims, or tactical-effect claims. Factual event-frequency summaries over the fixed historical sample, such as recorded-event counts, are allowed and are not player rankings.
sources.next_gate: Keep the clean-release identity test and visible attribution/no-endorsement wording bound to every release. Reopen admission before adding any Players field, identity asset, or broader player claim.

sources.title: OpenFootball World Cup 2026 source and generated JSON
sources.version_season: upstream worldcup commit 606b6747ed8e0026aaf25ef86cb09d603da9844f; generated worldcup.json commit 5e4bc62f9e711f3ea83d2b150ac3200e7e9c90a0; 2026 season
sources.license: CC0 1.0 Universal as declared by both repositories; license file SHA-256 36ffd9dc085d529a7e60e1276d73ae5a030b020313e6c5408593a6ae2af39673
sources.local_path: not retained; inspected in a temporary directory; future pinned raw file belongs at data/raw/openfootball/worldcup-2026.json
sources.schema_units: Generated JSON match records with round/number, date, time and UTC offset, team labels, optional score/goals, group, and ground; upstream Football.TXT source
sources.coverage: Pinned JSON parses to 104 canonical match tuples and 48 team labels; 102 score-present records and 2 future score-absent fixtures at retrieval; 72 group records omit match number and 32 knockout records include it; current tournament context only
sources.known_gaps: Manually updated pin-time snapshot, not live; no explicit completion/status field; team naming is provider text and differs across providers; ground is location text, not guaranteed stadium; no event, tracking, formation, pressure, line-height, or physical metrics; no crest/flag/photo rights
sources.product_use: Potentially show provenance-linked 2026 tournament/fixture context with score/goals stripped, separately from the 2018 historical tactical evidence; no cross-provider team join or tactical use
sources.next_gate: After P0 freeze and organizer scope clarification, implement a checksum-verified fixture-only transform with canonical keys, nullable match numbers, fixed-offset time parsing, RFC3339 snapshot metadata, and isolation tests; re-pin before both freezes
